title: Payment Gateway Guidelines and Charges
section: |     | Guidelines for Submitting PAN Application through UTIITSL website/portal and Making payment online  |   | --- |   | option now available for Form No.93 (For Indian Citizen), Form No.94 (For Indian Entities),Form No.95 (For Foreign Citizen),Form No.96 (For Foreign Entities) ,CR-01 (Change/Correction in PAN Card details for Individual) and CR-02 (Change/Correction in PAN Card details for Non-Individual):  |   | International cards are not accepted, use Indian cards for making the requisite payments. |   |   |   |  1) Applicant should fill in his/her New PAN Application or Change request Application "online" through UTIITSL's site http://www.utiitsl.com/ under the menu option Services->PAN Card->Apply. Instructions for filling up the form as provided on the website should be followed while filling up each information on the form. |   |  |   | 2) Applicant should click on "Validation" followed by "Submit" button once the application is filled in. |   |  |   | 3) The filled-in application form is visible on the screen for thorough verification by the applicant. Applicant should verify it for correctness of the information being submitted. |   |  |   | 4) If verified correct, Applicant can now go ahead with making online payment by clicking on "Make Payment" button on this form  |   |  |   | 5) The applicant will be redirected to the BillDesk Payment Gateway to proceed with the payment. The applicant can select the appropriate payment option based on the availability of their card-issuing bank and the payment options supported by BillDesk. |   |  |   | 6) Applicant needs to carry out the payment attempt with his/her card details using one of the following options: Netbanking, Credit Card (Master/Visa), Debit Card (Master/Visa), Cash Card or any other as seen available on the Payment Gateway site. |   |  |   | 7) Applicant may get a "Success" or a "Failure" as a result of this online payment attempt, accordingly the message will be displayed clearly. |   |  |   | 8) On payment "Failure", message of failed transaction will be system-endorsed on the filled-in form visible on the screen. Applicant may either Cancel, go back OR Retry making the payment. |   |  |   | 9) On payment "Success", payment confirmation will be system-endorsed on the filled-in. |   |  |   | 10) For "Success" cases, Applicant should "Save" OR take a print-out of the filled-in form visible on the screen through the "Print Form" option provided. |   |  |
